name: Highway Blossoms
source:
Developed by Alienworks, Highway Blossoms is a short yuri story set in the American Southwest. After an old gold rush miner's journal is discovered, a nationwide craze begins as would-be prospectors try to solve the cryptic clues it contains and discover the miner's hidden treasure. Amber, couldn't care less. Wandering the Midwest in an inherited motorhome, she mourns the loss of her grandfather, totally unaware of the hunt taking place around her. It's not until she meets Marina, a young hitchhiker wandering through the deserts of New Mexico, that things start to look up.

[From [url=http://highwayblossoms.com/about-2/]The Official Website[/url]]
translation:
《公路繁花》由Alienworks开发，是一部以美国西南部为背景的短篇百合故事。一位淘金热时期矿工的日记被发现后，全国掀起热潮，寻宝者纷纷试图解开其中隐晦的线索，找到矿工留下的宝藏。安柏对此毫不关心。她开着继承来的房车在中西部漫游，哀悼祖父的离世，完全不知道寻宝热潮正在发生。直到她遇见在新墨西哥州沙漠间搭便车旅行的年轻女孩玛丽娜，生活才开始有了起色。

[来源：[url=http://highwayblossoms.com/about-2/]官方网站[/url]]
